title: Validation and testing before applying in production

videos.script: A change can pass review, push cleanly, and still break the network. {{bad}} So where do you check it? Before it reaches a router, or after? {{when}} Before is better, because a failure there costs nothing. The network never notices. {{before}} In this lesson the data gets a model that refuses a typo, a bad address and an unknown word. {{model}} Then pytest tests the files: no address used twice, every OSPF interface with its network line. {{offline}} Then it asks the routers whether the network does what the data says. {{online}} And you push a change that passes every one of those checks, and breaks a link anyway. {{break}} You revert it, and write the one test that would have caught it, with no router at all. {{fix}}
